en: Burn
zh-Hans: 灼烧
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Status.Burn (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Deals damage every second for a few seconds.
zh-Hans: 持续几秒，每秒受到伤害。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Status.Burn. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Shock
zh-Hans: 感电
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Status.Shock (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: A Shocked enemy takes more damage from everything.
zh-Hans: 感电的敌人受到的所有伤害提高。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Status.Shock. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Chill
zh-Hans: 减速
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Status.Chill (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Slows the enemy. Chill stacks: enough stacks Freeze it.
zh-Hans: 让敌人变慢。可以叠加，叠满就会冻结。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Status.Chill. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Freeze
zh-Hans: 冻结
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Status.Freeze (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: The enemy can't move or attack for a short time. Bosses can't be Frozen.
zh-Hans: 敌人短时间内不能移动或攻击。首领不会被冻结。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Status.Freeze. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Split
zh-Hans: 分裂
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Split (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: A bullet breaks into smaller bullets when it hits or ends its flight. They deal less damage.
zh-Hans: 子弹命中或飞到尽头时，分成几发小子弹。分出的子弹伤害较低。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Split. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Arc
zh-Hans: 电弧
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Chain (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Lightning that jumps from a hit to a nearby enemy for part of the damage.
zh-Hans: 命中时，闪电跳到附近的敌人身上，造成部分伤害。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Chain. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Echo
zh-Hans: 回响
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Echo (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: A delayed strike on the same impact point.
zh-Hans: 回响会在同一命中点延迟打出一次攻击。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Echo. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Cleave
zh-Hans: 横斩
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.ConvertMelee (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: A sweeping arc in front of you that hits every enemy inside it, instead of a bullet that flies.
zh-Hans: 在你面前横扫出一道弧形斩击，击中范围内的所有敌人，而不是射出子弹。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.ConvertMelee. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Damage zone
zh-Hans: 伤害区域
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Field (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: A patch of ground that hurts enemies standing in it for a short time.
zh-Hans: 一片地面，在短时间内伤害站在里面的敌人。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Field. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Slam
zh-Hans: 重砸
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Slam (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: A ring that bursts out of the ground around you, hitting everything near you.
zh-Hans: 以你为中心，从地面砸出一圈冲击，击中身边的一切。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Slam. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Pull
zh-Hans: 吸拢
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Pull (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Drags enemies toward a point, bunching them together.
zh-Hans: 把敌人拉向一点，聚成一团。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Pull. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Status
zh-Hans: 状态
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.StatusApply (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Hits may apply a Keeper's status to the enemy.
zh-Hans: 命中时可能让敌人带上司者的状态。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.StatusApply. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Stand still
zh-Hans: 站定
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Stillness (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Not moving. Some effects charge up while you stand still and fire with your next volley.
zh-Hans: 原地不动。有些效果在你站定时蓄力，随下一次齐射打出。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Stillness. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Ricochet
zh-Hans: 弹射
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Ricochet (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: After a hit, the bullet bounces on to another enemy.
zh-Hans: 子弹命中后，弹向另一个敌人。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Ricochet. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Mark
zh-Hans: 标记
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Status.Mark (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Hunted by Shade. Tracking rounds and Shades go for Marked enemies first.
zh-Hans: 被司幽盯上。追踪子弹和亡影优先追向被标记的敌人。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Status.Mark. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Blind
zh-Hans: 致盲
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Status.Blind (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Stuns the enemy briefly: it can't move or shoot. Bosses can't be Blinded.
zh-Hans: 让敌人短暂眩晕，不能移动也不能射击。首领不会被致盲。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Status.Blind. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Tracking
zh-Hans: 追踪
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Seek (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Bullets bend in flight toward their target, Marked enemies first.
zh-Hans: 子弹在飞行中拐向目标，优先追向被标记的敌人。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Seek. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Shade
zh-Hans: 亡影
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Hunter (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: An ally raised from a kill. It fires your weapon for a while.
zh-Hans: 从被击杀的敌人身上召出的友方影子，会用你的武器射击一段时间。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Hunter. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Debt
zh-Hans: 债
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Debt (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Counts Marked kills. When full, your next volley hunts every enemy on screen.
zh-Hans: 记下标记击杀的数目。记满时，你的下一次齐射会追踪全屏的敌人。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Debt. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Charged shot
zh-Hans: 蓄能弹
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Charge (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Every few shots a weapon fires one charged shot that deals much more damage.
zh-Hans: 每隔几发，武器会射出一发蓄能弹，伤害大幅提高。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Charge. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Lance
zh-Hans: 光矛
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.CritSplit (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: A crit breaks into smaller lances of light. Lances never split again.
zh-Hans: 暴击分裂成几道小光矛。光矛不会再次分裂。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.CritSplit. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Burst
zh-Hans: 光爆
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.Nova (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Damage past a kill bursts in light around the target.
zh-Hans: 多余的伤害在目标周围炸成光。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.Nova. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Dash volley
zh-Hans: 冲刺齐射
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.VolleyOnDash (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Dashing fires your weapons along the dash.
zh-Hans: 冲刺时武器沿冲刺方向齐射。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.VolleyOnDash. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Momentum
zh-Hans: 动量
Context: Keyword note term, the word cards use for Flag.SpeedScale (Docs/Glossary.md, keepers.md Text).

en: Built by moving and dashing; each point adds damage and fire rate. Getting hit loses some.
zh-Hans: 移动和冲刺时积累，每点都提高伤害和射速。被击中会失去一部分。
Context: Keyword note under the card on hover or focus for Flag.SpeedScale. Plain, number-free, <= 20 words en / 40 chars zh.

en: Duo
zh-Hans: 双司
Context: Keyword note term (keyword_glossary.md).

en: An advance that belongs to both of your Keepers and strengthens their reaction.
zh-Hans: 同时属于你两位司者的预支，会强化它们的反应。
Context: Keyword note under a duo card (keyword_glossary.md).

en: Reaction
zh-Hans: 反应
Context: Keyword note term (keyword_glossary.md).

en: When two Keepers' effects meet on one enemy, something new happens.
zh-Hans: 两位司者的效果落在同一个敌人身上时，会产生新的效果。
Context: Keyword note under a duo card (keyword_glossary.md).
